     FROM lightning.metastore.cartograph.provenance.code_change c LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.cartograph.provenance.pull_request p ON p.id = c.pr_id
     WHERE c.repo_id = 'siddarth-ba-72/Interview-Prep-Pilot-AI' AND ((lower(COALESCE(c.subject, '')) LIKE '%aiclient%' AND lower(COALESCE(c.subject, '')) LIKE '%ai/test/generate%' AND lower(COALESCE(c.subject, '')) LIKE '%ai/test/evaluate%' AND lower(COALESCE(c.subject, '')) LIKE '%topic learning%') OR (lower(COALESCE(c.body, '')) LIKE '%aiclient%' AND lower(COALESCE(c.body, '')) LIKE '%ai/test/generate%' AND lower(COALESCE(c.body, '')) LIKE '%ai/test/evaluate%' AND lower(COALESCE(c.body, '')) LIKE '%topic learning%') OR (lower(COALESCE(p.title, '')) LIKE '%aiclient%' AND lower(COALESCE(p.title, '')) LIKE '%ai/test/generate%' AND lower(COALESCE(p.title, '')) LIKE '%ai/test/evaluate%' AND lower(COALESCE(p.title, '')) LIKE '%topic learning%') OR (lower(COALESCE(p.body, '')) LIKE '%aiclient%' AND lower(COALESCE(p.body, '')) LIKE '%ai/test/generate%' AND lower(COALESCE(p.body, '')) LIKE '%ai/test/evaluate%' AND lower(COALESCE(p.body, '')) LIKE '%topic learning%'))

output.answer: The Topics and preparation API depends on the AI orchestration service because the AiClient was created to support the 'create and learn topic' functionality, which requires streaming learn data and generating/evaluating test content via the AI service endpoints. This dependency was introduced in commit fb749709b6 by siddarth-ba-72 on 2026-07-23 to implement the new topic learning and testing features.

output.answer: The Topic service's AiClient was designed to orchestrate AI interactions for topic learning and testing, calling /ai/learn/stream, /ai/test/generate, and /ai/test/evaluate to support the create-and-learn feature and mock interview flow. The dependency was introduced when the AiClient class was implemented to route requests to these three endpoints, as shown in its method signatures and the commit that added the learn topic functionality. The AiClient was created to centralize AI calls for topic-related features, enabling streamed learning and test generation/evaluation within the backend.

claims.text: AiClient.java lines 58-78 define three AI endpoints: /ai/learn/stream, /ai/test/generate, and /ai/test/evaluate, showing the service depends on all three endpoints.

The AiClient was created to centralize AI calls for topic-related features, enabling streamed learning and test generation/evaluation within the backend.
